title: 小包
text: 一个{item:bag_long}，正好装得下{item:longsword}，或者装得下{item:knife}加{item:poison_vial}。两套只带得走一套 —— 前面又是岔路，{c:warn}先看对手再合成、再装包{/c}。

texts.en: A {item:bag_long}. It fits the {item:longsword}, or the {item:knife} plus the {item:poison_vial}. You can only take one set. Another fork is ahead: {c:warn}check the enemy first, then craft, then pack{/c}.
